name: HVAC
metaDescription: The 2026 HVAC Industry Report from Sherlock Research: market size, growth forecasts, competitive landscape, and local benchmarks for U.S. HVAC operators.
ogDescription: Market size, growth, competitive landscape, and local benchmarks for the U.S. HVAC services industry. 40+ pages, instant PDF.
heroDescription: Comprehensive data and local insights to help HVAC contractors price service plans, plan inventory through the refrigerant transition, and capture heat-pump demand.
summary: Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning market intelligence. Demand shifts, pricing pressure, buyer decision drivers, and regional analysis.
lead: The U.S. HVAC industry is in the middle of a generational transition: heat-pump adoption, the R-410A phase-down, and extreme-weather demand are all reshaping the market simultaneously. Operators who modernize quickly are positioned to take share.

reviews.title: Captured 40% more heat-pump leads
reviews.text: The buyer-behavior section told us exactly which homeowner segments were open to switching from gas furnaces. We retargeted our ad spend to those zip codes and our heat-pump close rate went from 18% to 31% in one season.
reviews.cite: Robert P., Owner, full-service HVAC contractor

reviews.title: Priced our service plan correctly
reviews.text: We'd been selling maintenance plans at $189/year because that's what the competitor down the road charged. The report showed our local market would pay $279–$329 for a slightly tiered offering. Repriced and recurring revenue grew 38%.

reviews.title: Made the right refrigerant call
reviews.text: We were going to wait on A2L training and equipment. The report's transition timeline and the competitive scan changed our mind — we got certified ahead of the local pack and now we're the go-to for new installs.
